excerpt.zh:
我们遭遇的深空无人机似乎是自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。根据加工设备的状况来判断，这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在我们试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。

或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但仍应该密切观察它们。

texts.zh:
我们遭遇的深空无人机似乎是自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。根据加工设备的状况来判断，这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在我们试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。

或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但仍应该密切观察它们。
texts.en:
The deep-space drones we have encountered appear to be the workers and custodians of autonomous orbital mining operations. Judging by the state of the processing equipment, these sites were established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves. The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward us when approached.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch.

texts.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机，这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。它们的功能很明确——采矿——但是是谁下的命令，目前我们还不得而知，很显然没有任何矿物在百年乃至千年内曾从这个恒星系出口过。

尽管这些可能只是老旧的无人机，但是[Root.Owner.GetName]还是应该注意一下它们。
texts.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment. Their purpose is obvious enough - mining - but who it is that tasked them is not immediately apparent. What is obvious is that no shipment of minerals has been retrieved from this system in hundreds, if not thousands of years.

They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们在某个恒星系里发现了深空无人机。这些无人机似乎是千年以前进行自动轨道采矿作业的矿机和监视用机器，但在不久之后采矿行动就被人放弃了，只剩无人机在继续运作。

这些无人机似乎没有任何通讯协议——至少没有[Root.Owner.GetName]能破译的协议——并对进入了恒星系的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船采取了攻击行为。

在[Root.System.GetName]发现这种无人机实在是喜人的收获，我们应该进一步研究一下。
texts.en:
Reports of deep-space drones in certain systems have been investigated. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones seem to lack any diplomatic comms protocols - at least any decipherable by the [Root.Owner.GetName] - and react with hostility to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] ships entering the system.

Their presence in the [Root.System.GetName] system is intriguing, and we should attempt to learn more about them.

texts.zh:
我们对关于此前遭遇的深空无人机的报告进行了进一步的调查。这些无人机似乎是数百万年前建造的自动轨道采矿作业的工人和监工。这些采矿作业似乎开始于数千年前，然后很快被抛弃，只留下了无人机继续运作。

这些无人机拥有强力的采矿激光，并且在[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]舰船试图靠近时表现出了明显具有威胁性，甚至是侵略性的举动。或许它们只是些老旧的无人机，但[Owner.GetName]仍应该密切观察它们。
texts.en:
Reports of the deep-space drones previously encountered have been investigated closer. The drones appear to be the workers and custodians of an autonomous orbital mining operation, established millennia ago and then soon abandoned by all but the drones themselves, judging by the state of the processing equipment.

The drones possess powerful mining lasers and make obviously threatening, if not outright hostile, overtures toward [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] vessels when approached. They may only be old drones, but they should be kept under close watch by the [Owner.GetName].

texts.zh:
无人机在其小行星上永无休止地对不断减少的资源进行开采。对其进行研究的过程较为枯燥，但仍具有研究价值。事实上，我们可以学到如何在最大化开采效率的同时减少能源消耗。

另外，我们发现无人机并非完全处于静默。它们会发出脉冲信号，不过频率极低并且波长很难与背景杂讯区分开来。是否有人在接收这些脉冲信号就不得而知了。
texts.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, we could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. Whether there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery better left for another time.

texts.zh:
除了对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船进行威胁的时候，这些无人机只会进行机械化的采矿工作。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
texts.en:
When not posturing with their mining lasers aimed at [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships, the drones appear steadfast and dumbly hard-working, hacking away at mineral-poor asteroids for want of something better to do.

What is more interesting is that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to earlier assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

texts.zh:
这些无人机的挖掘效率比十分优秀，要是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的矿工的话，这些地方可能早就被认为是挖无可挖了。我们的高级工程师正在将这些无人机的运作方式应用在[Root.GetName]的复合矿场和太空港中以增加我们的采矿效率，减少能源浪费。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，虽然不是非常频繁，但用的却是一种很难从杂音中识别出的信号。不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
texts.en:
The drones are remarkably efficient at squeezing ever-diminishing returns from rocks [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] miners would have soon discarded, deemed exhausted of all worthwhile mineral content. Our top engineers are working on adapting the drones' methodology for use in the [Root.GetName]'s Mining Networks and Stations which should improve efficiency, effectively lessening energy expenditure.

Of lesser import is the fact that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to previous assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

texts.zh:
无人机在他们所在的小行星上永无休止的对不断减少的资源进行开采，这一单调的过程很值得研究。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的复合矿场可以从中学到如何在保存能源的同时最大化的提取矿物。

此外，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会偶尔发射声脉冲信号，而且这些声脉冲信号的波长很难和背景杂音区分开，是否有人收到这些声脉冲就不得而知了。
texts.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, Mining Networks on [Root.Capital.GetName] could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

label.zh: 真是神妙的自动装置啊。

texts.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理远古采矿无人机的相关数据。
texts.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Ancient Mining Drones.
